name: Hotel Oberwirt
beschreibung: The Hotel Oberwirt is centrally located in Ebbs and is an ideal starting point for excursions into the surrounding mountain world. The atmosphere of the hotel is characterized by traditional Tiroler charm and warm hospitality. The rooms offer a successful combination of modern comfort and an alpine living feel. In the dining area, regional products and classic Austrian dishes are served. The surroundings of the Kaiserwinkl region invite you to a variety of activities such as hiking and skiing. A wellness area provides relaxation and recuperation after an active day.
